item.description: Have you taken the safety research survey designed by the Roofing Alliance and Texas A&M University?

item.title: Award-Winning Safety Products from IRE 2026
item.description: Products dedicated to roofer safety earned high praise from IRE 2026 attendees.

item.title: Selling Shingles on Beauty and Performance
item.description: The balance between curb appeal and durability is a concern for most homeowners. GAF Timberline HDZ® shingles represent a legacy of relentless innovation, delivering the peak performance and dependability customers trust.

item.title: New Data Reframes U.S. Housing Shortage
item.description: A new analysis finds the U.S. housing shortage has eased since 2022, signaling steadier new construction and more roofing demand from remodeling and replacement work.

item.title: Traveling Roofing Scammers Target Seniors
item.description: Police say traveling scammers are targeting seniors with fraudulent roofing offers, causing intentional damage and demanding large cash payments for unnecessary repairs.

item.title: How Roofing’s Next Generation Is Shaping the Industry’s Future
item.description: The roofing industry’s next generation of leaders join multiple RC Young Guns alumni to help steer the pathway to success in the annual workshop.

item.title: One Door at a Time
item.description: Ian Smith’s love for roofing was born pounding the pavement, going door-to-door carrying a sales kit and a boatload of good intentions for homeowners faced with replacing a roof.

item.title: Living the Brand
item.description: Gavin May was a young father already working in the trades when he found his way into the roofing industry. At 25, he was earning money working as a countertop programmer running CNC machines, but he just couldn’t see a future in it.

item.title: Remote Roofing
item.description: Imagine a roofing sales process executed successfully over the phone, available remotely anywhere, anytime. Griffin Libhart could see it and is part of the team implementing the revolutionary process at One Day Roofing.

item.title: Hands-on Experience and Digital Fluency
item.description: Being underestimated is Bradley Rathjen's competitive advantage. At 23, the estimator and project manager at Madsen Roofing & Waterproofing in Sacramento, Calif., has learned that when clients doubt you because of your age, there's only one response: become undeniable.
